methodology.scope: Named identity-stable characters evidenced in Arthitean/Arthratan-related email canon, including Arthiteans, non-Arthitean allies and antagonists, simulation/constructed adversaries, and attachment-established named identities.
methodology.precedence: Later explicit canon corrections and retroactive-rewrite instructions supersede older contradictory descriptions.
methodology.privacy: Real-world correspondents are not published as fictional character pages merely because they appear in the email transport layer; fictional avatar/reincarnation identities are represented by their canon names.
methodology.certainty: Missing facts are listed as gaps rather than inferred. Contextual lineage labels are marked as such when an email gives only a first name, and same-name identities are not merged without an explicit source link.
audit_notes: Later email canon explicitly lists Annaris and Deyhamora separately among the Seven Disasters; the older compound page-title has been corrected.
Four of the Seven Disasters remain unnamed in the recovered email prose audited for this edition.
The Kaelen identity graph remains unresolved: Kaelen Redalious, Lord Kaelen, High Lord Kaelen of the Vanguard, and the early Grand Architect Kaelen usage are not silently merged.
Real-world correspondent identities remain outside the public character roster unless a clearly separable fictional avatar/reincarnation identity exists.
